subject: Private deployment pricing — token volumes, env count & support tier follow-up
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing — token volumes, env count & support tier follow-up

Hi Alice — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a targeted pricing workup for EdgeHealth's private/VPC deployment: 

Call recap (brief)
- Use case: patient-facing summarization + clinician-assist workflows (sensitive PHI; data stays in customer VPC).
- Preferred deployment: Private/VPC (US region) with enterprise support and SOC2 evidence.
- Expected start: pilot in Q3, scale in next 6–12 months.

Clarifying questions / asks from our side (to confirm before we price)
1) Current expected token profile: can you confirm a baseline month today (input tokens + output tokens) and a 12-month growth target? You mentioned a moderate ramp; an exact monthly token figure helps the math.
2) Environments: confirm number of separate environments you want instrumented (prod, staging, dev, analytics, etc.). We typically price per-environment license + committed token buckets for private deployments.
3) Budget range: it helps if you can indicate a target budget for year 1 (we'll align options to that bracket).
4) Support: confirm desired support tier (Standard business hours / Premium 24x7 / Enterprise named SLA). Enterprise support adds a premium but includes faster SLAs and compliance handling.

Attached: initial pricing sheet template and a blank SOW so legal/procurement can see the shape. If you prefer, we can run two options: (A) committed token bucket + per-env license (our recommended), or (B) BYO infra + Redwood private control plane license.

Next steps
- If you can reply with the items above, I’ll produce two concrete pricing options (numbers + unit economics: $/1M tokens) and a short one-page SOW.
- Rafael (cc'd) will own the technical pricing assumptions; Lauren will coordinate procurement touches.

Thanks — talk soon,

— Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0137

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — token volumes, env count & support tier follow-up

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below so you can run the numbers: 

1) Token profile (current / 12-month plan)
- Baseline month (pilot): ~30 million tokens/month total (this is input+output aggregated).
- 12-month ramp target: ~60 million tokens/month (we expect traffic growth after clinical integration).

2) Environments
- We need 3 environments initially: production, staging (near-prod), and dev. We may add a separate analytics environment later but not in year 1.

3) Budget range (year 1)
- Handing over a rough procurement band: $250k — $350k total for the first 12 months (including licensing + support + committed usage). Procurement will prefer an annual number they can PO to.

4) Support tier
- We need Enterprise support (24x7) and SOC2 compliance support for security reviews. Named contacts for escalation are required.

Other notes
- We prefer committed capacity + license (option A) over BYO if the economics work.
- Procurement timeline: aiming to have commercial terms and an SOW by end of May; PO in June/July.

Happy to jump back on a quick 30-min call if that helps — otherwise please send two price options and a short SOW we can share with legal/procurement.

Thanks,

— Alice Morgan
Head of Product | EdgeHealth
alice@edgehealth.com | +1 617-555-0210

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — token volumes, env count & support tier follow-up

Great — this is very helpful, Alice. Based on the 30M / 60M tokens profile and 3 environments + Enterprise support, we will prepare two firm options. High-level preview so procurement has context: 

Option A — Reserved + Per-env license (recommended for predictable economics)
- Model: per-environment subscription + committed token bucket (monthly) + enterprise support uplift.
- Example anchor pricing (preview, subject to SOW/legal):
  • Per-environment license: $2,500 / month / env (so 3 envs = $7,500 / month).
  • Committed token rate: $750 per 1M tokens (applies to committed bucket).
  • Enterprise support uplift: 18% on top of subscription + token spend (named SLA, 24x7).
- Illustration (month 1 at 30M tokens):
  • Token cost: 30 * $750 = $22,500 / month
  • Env fees: $7,500 / month
  • Subtotal: $30,000 / month => $360,000 / year (before any committed discount / implementation credit).

Option B — BYO infra license (lower infra ops involvement; higher token unit price)
- Model: single private control plane license + support; customer supplies GPUs. Lower per-env fee, higher $/1M token rate.
- Example anchor pricing (preview):
  • Private control plane license: $10,000 / month (flat across envs)
  • Token rate: $950 per 1M tokens
  • Enterprise support uplift: 12% (support covers orchestration & critical SLAs but not infra ops).
- Illustration (30M tokens): 30 * $950 = $28,500 + $10,000 = $38,500 / month => $462k / year.

Comments / next steps
- Option A maps directly into the $250k–$350k band if we apply a modest committed discount or implementation credit for year 1 (we can structure a $30–$50k implementation credit to bring year 1 near the midpoint of your band).
- We’ll produce a precise worksheet with line items, a short SOW, and a recommended first-year commitment that balances spend and runway.

Action items from us: Rafael and I will lock the worksheet and provide a one-page pricing summary + SOW draft by EOD Friday. Lauren will include procurement/legal touchpoints for PO timelines.

If that looks directionally right, I’ll schedule a 30-min commercial review next week (Rafael to join for technical Qs).

Best,

— Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0137

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pricing assumptions & technical checklist for EdgeHealth (do not forward)

Internal note — quick technical assumptions I'm using in the worksheet: 
- Token mix: assume 30M tokens / month (50% input / 50% output) for pilot; scale plan to 60M in 12 months for capacity planning.
- Concurrency & latency targets: 99th percentile latency SLO 200ms for clinical assistant paths; batching expected for non-interactive summarization.
- Encrypted KV cache retained in customer VPC; customer will expose KMS/HSM keys.
- Compliance: SOC2 + annual audit evidence; legal will need log retention plan.

Pre-reqs to confirm with customer before SOW:
- Final list of envs and CIDR ranges / VPC peering plan
- Certs and KMS contact for onboarding
- Procurement preferred billing entity and PO template

I’ll include these assumptions in the SOW appendix. Sergio — confirm if we want to push a $30k implementation credit in year 1 (recommended) to land inside their band.

— Rafael
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
